description: qcom API observability — per-endpoint request rate, error/success rate, and latency percentiles (RED method). Data from the http_request_duration_seconds histogram.

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])), 1e-9)
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])))

spec.description: One row per API route. Sort by any column to find the slowest or most error-prone endpoints.
spec.title: Per-endpoint summary

spec.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m]))))

topk(10, 100 * sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])), 1e-9))

100 * sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])), 1e-9)

100 * sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"[23].."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])), 1e-9)

100 * sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])), 1e-9)

100 * sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"4.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])), 1e-9)

spec.description: p95 request latency, one line per route. Honours the Route filter.
spec.title: Per-endpoint latency (p95)

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="qcom", env=~"$env", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[5m])), 1e-9)

spec.description: 5xx error rate as a percentage of requests, one line per route. Honours the Route filter.

spec.description: p95 latency of outgoing calls, one line per dependency.

spec.description: Share of outgoing calls returning HTTP 2xx, one line per dependency.
spec.title: External success rate (%)
